item.title: Celebrity Influence on FAANG: How Star Power Shapes Big Tech Perception
item.description: This article explores how celebrity partnerships, endorsements, and public opinions influence how people view major technology companies.

item.title: Letter – Shared home ownership?
item.description: Letter: Carrollton resident Thomas Finderson argues seniors could sell individual homes and jointly buy one, freeing cash, cutting costs, boosting companionship and freeing houses for younger buyers.

item.title: The Pros and Cons of Selling Your Home to Travel the World
The Basics of Economic and Non Economic Damages in Personal Injuries.
item.description: Compensation is usually a big issue when an individual suffers as a result of the negligence of the other party.

item.title: When Big Trucks Cause Big Damage
item.description: When there is an awful truck accident involving you or a loved one in Georgia, having an experienced legal representative will be the difference in determining the outcome of your case.

item.title: From First Launch to Activation in iOS Applications
item.description: A quick look at recent iOS releases shows a pattern. Many apps lose new users within the first session.

item.title: Letter – Terrible decision on Kemp’s Village
item.description: Letter: Carrollton resident condemns Isle of Wight leaders for approving 35 Kemp’s Village condos on narrow Cedar Grove Road despite traffic and neighborhood concerns.

item.title: Roughly 150 Smithfield High students walk out in anti-ICE protest
item.description: Roughly 150 Smithfield High School students participated in an anti-ICE walkout on Feb. 27, the latest of several student-led protests across the state and nation.

item.title: School Board adopts plan to address Hardy Elementary ‘off track’ rating
item.description: Isle of Wight’s School Board approved a three-year plan for Hardy Elementary after a federal finding resulted in an “off track" rating under Virginia's new school evaluation system.

item.title: IW supervisors vote to keep 2026 car tax rate unchanged
item.description: Isle of Wight is keeping its 2026 car tax at $4.50 per $100.
